questions.q: What did Norah do with her doll after finding it?
questions.explain: Norah was very happy after finding her doll.

questions.q: How did Norah's mother feel when she gave Selah back to Norah?
questions.explain: Norah's mother gave Selah back to Norah to make her happy.

questions.q: What did Norah do every night?
questions.explain: Norah slept with her doll every night.
